entries.50dcabca1f335735: This is a single-segment business operating the 100-yen shop “Seria.” Its merchandise consists of general merchandise and confectionery and food, and revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥255,695 million. As of March 31, 2026, the number of stores totaled 2,134, consisting of 2,101 directly operated stores and 33 FC stores.

entries.c3564a207a445376: This business sells products (consumer goods) to consumers through directly operated stores. Revenue from directly operated stores in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥253,162 million, accounting for 99.0% of total revenue. In the current fiscal year, 117 directly operated stores were opened and 53 were closed.
entries.e79e34ee364eca9a: This business sells products wholesale to franchisees and major customers. FC stores is the collective term for stores with which the company has a basic contract for use of its product ordering system; as of March 31, 2026, there were 33 such stores. It also exports to overseas FC stores and sells wholesale to domestic agents; revenue from FC stores in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,972 million, and combined revenue from wholesale and overseas sales was ¥561 million.
entries.f4067428a6199f7d: A retail chain that operates the 100-yen shop 'Seria' nationwide, selling sundries, confectionery, and food at a uniform price of ¥100 excluding tax.
